# FLX-3117: a generator plugin is not installed where its code is

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A plugin loads only from an installation directory of this interpreter: the purelib and platlib directories of its sysconfig, and the user site when it is enabled. The distribution's metadata directory must lie under one of them. Unless the distribution is an editable install, the origin of the entry point's top-level module must lie under the same directory, be listed in the distribution's RECORD, and lie under none of the bundle directory, the state directory and the current directory, so that a .dist-info folder beside a bundle, or a module that python finds first in the current directory, cannot stand in for an installed plugin. The message names the paths found. Install the plugin with a package installer into this interpreter, and run the command from another directory. Nothing was imported.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3117
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
